name: Ropecon
blurb: Finland's largest convention: a tabletop role-playing, board game and cosplay event held each summer in Helsinki.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Thank you all! Ropecon 2027 will be held 30th of July – 1st of August'; venue/city confirmed via web search (Messukeskus, Helsinki).

notes: The Guests of Honor page is still titled and dated for the 2026 event ('Guests of Honor 2026', 'ROPECON 2026 | 24.–26.7.2026') which has already happened, listing Katrine Wind and Louise Sugden; 2027 Guests of Honor had not been posted as of this session, so guests is 'none-yet'. The 2027 venue/city (Messukeskus, Helsinki) was confirmed via web search rather than directly in the homepage's 'thank you' date announcement, which names only the dates.
